page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page. Running head at the top. Page number at the top right. Faint, illegible marginal text from the facing page along the left edge, not transcribed.

main_text.p: [?]édatus. Quam vecors pertinacia! quæ totâ vitâ ratum id habet, quod è prava nutrice suxit infans, quod quondam puero persuasit pappus, quod impofuerunt nocturna terricula, quod inflixit sub ferula magister: Hæc sunt, quæ primam indolem formavêre, hæc congenita nobiscum, hæc ipsa Natura videtur insevisse: religioni ducimus ea concutere: Stramine ligatur Stultitia: Cur caput non exerimus è turbâ? quid hîc periculi, ô miselli? Fidite: pacatiora sunt hîc omnia: Inscitia vulgi, fulminum ictibus infamat superiora: Quia nubes æquat sideribus, putat fumis nostris involvi Solem: Imum est, insani, quod elusis oculis suspicitis inter altissima: Si assurgere non piget, si æquo animo dissentimus à plebe, jam crepundia rejecimus, jam prætex-

page.notes: The first word at the top left is unclear; the initial letter may be damaged. The letter at the start of "nocturna" (printed "sturna") is partly hidden by the binding edge and is read as N with a query. The left margin carries faint show-through from the facing page and no legible notes.
